verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has a documented REST API (V3, PHP/Node SDKs, OAuth2 client) and even an official MCP server with 145 tools covering the API, indicating strong programmatic/agentic access. However, no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found at expected endpoints, and no first-party evidence of official API reference docs was surfaced, only SDKs and probes.
